questions.question: A company uses antivirus software to scan emails and attachments for malware before they are opened by employees. What type of threat is most likely to evade this security measure?
content: Phishing attacks
Ransomware
Fileless malware
Social engineering tactics

questions.question: A company has a firewall that blocks all incoming traffic from the internet except for traffic coming from trusted IP addresses such as those of its own employees and partners.
content: This would be considered an open-firewall policy
This would be considered a private-firewall policy
This would be considered a secure-firewall policy
This would be considered a public-firewall policy

questions.question: A firewall is used to protect a computer system from unauthorized access through what type of traffic?
content: DNS traffic
FTP traffic
Network traffic
Email traffic

questions.question: What is the primary function of a firewall in blocking unauthorized access to a computer network?
content: Identifying and isolating infected devices
Blocking known malicious traffic patterns
Screening incoming and outgoing network traffic
Encrypting all data transmitted over the network

questions.question: An organization discovers that their business email account has been compromised in an Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) attack, but only a single email was intercepted and read by attackers.
content: The organization's employees should immediately change all of their passwords to prevent any further unauthorized access.
The organization's IT department should conduct a thorough forensic analysis to determine the extent of the attack's impact on company data.
The organization's chief financial officer (CFO) should be informed and decide how to proceed with handling the compromised email account.
All employees' devices and networks should be immediately quarantined to prevent any potential further damage.

questions.question: An organization's Endpoint Security policy requires all employees to keep their laptops up-to-date with the latest security patches and updates. Which of the following is an effective way for an employee to do this?
content: Manually installing each update
Enabling Automatic Updates on their laptop
Using a third-party software to install updates
Disabling the internet connection to prevent updates from being downloaded

questions.question: An organization discovers that an Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) group has been accessing their network for months, but has not caused any noticeable damage. What is the most likely motivation behind this behavior?
content: Financial gain through data exfiltration
Intelligence gathering to compromise other organizations
Sabotage and disruption of business operations
Personal revenge against a specific individual or group

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of installing endpoint security software, such as antivirus and firewall protection, on a school's laptops?
content: To monitor all internet activity for teacher supervision
To encrypt sensitive student data stored on school devices
To protect individual student devices from cyber threats when used off-campus
To secure and manage the entire school's Wi-Fi network

questions.question: What is the primary function of a firewall in a computer network?
content: To monitor incoming and outgoing network traffic
To protect sensitive data from unauthorized access
To act as a router for internet traffic
To scan for malware and viruses in real-time

questions.question: An Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) group has been tracking a company's network activity for months, but so far, they have only managed to compromise its external-facing systems. What is the most likely next step in their attack?
content: Launch a targeted phishing campaign against the company's employees.
Attempt to exploit zero-day vulnerabilities in the company's software.
Focus on gathering intelligence on the company's internal systems and networks.
Create a backdoor into the company's network through a compromised external system.

questions.question: A company has a firewall that blocks incoming traffic from its external network, but allows outgoing traffic to all networks. What is the primary benefit of this configuration?
content: Improved security against internal threats
Reduced costs by minimizing network equipment
Increased productivity due to unrestricted internet access
Enhanced network performance for online applications

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of endpoint protection software?
content: To protect user data from unauthorized access
To prevent malware attacks on mobile devices
To safeguard remote workers' laptops and desktops from cyber threats
To monitor and block suspicious network activity

questions.question: A school's firewall is configured to block all incoming connections by default, but allows outgoing connections for legitimate applications. What type of firewall configuration is this?
content: Permissive
restrictive
Stateful inspection
Hybrid

questions.question: What is the primary function of a Personal Identity Password (PIP) in endpoint security?
content: To verify user identity for all system access
To protect against data breaches and unauthorized access
To enable two-factor authentication
To generate secure cryptographic keys for encryption

questions.question: An organization's IT department discovers a malicious software (malware) infection in one of their employee's computers, but it is suspected that the attack may have originated from an internal source. What type of threat would this be classified as?
content: Phishing
Advanced Persistent Threat (APT)
Denial of Service (DoS)
Ransomware
